subject: Architecture
title: The National Museum of African American History
description: A quick, practical guide to The National Museum of African American History.

hook.text: David Adjaye wrapped the museum in bronze-coated aluminum panels inspired by freed slave ironwork.

buildup.text: The corona-shaped cladding references a Yoruba crown, tilted at the same angle as the Washington Monument.

discovery.text: Visitors descend underground first, starting with slavery, then rise upward through history.

twist.text: Congress authorized the museum in 2003. It took 13 years to design, fund, and build.

climax.text: Opening weekend drew 37,000 visitors. Timed entry passes sold out months in advance.

punchline.text: The building tells the story before you read a single plaque.

quiz.question: What inspired the museum's bronze-coated exterior panels?
